question: The gold price, crude oil price, real estate index of Jan 1, 2008
query: SELECT      DATE_TRUNC('year', finance_economics_dataset.date) AS year,     EXTRACT(MONTH FROM finance_economics_dataset.date) AS month,     CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (DATE '2008-01-01' + INTERVAL '1 day') - DATE '1970-01-01') / 86400.000005 AS INTEGER)::INTEGER AS day_of_year FROM      finance_economics_dataset WHERE      EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2008 AND     EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) = 1 AND     (DATE '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL 'day_of_the_week' - DATE '2008-01-02') <= ('date') LIMIT 50;
